speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the specific appearance of your longstanding rash and tell me if you notice any patterns, such as it appearing only after handling certain materials or during specific seasons. Additionally, when did the numbness and tingling in your palms first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Leishmaniasis (likely cutaneous and mucocutaneous given the rash, neuropathy, and rice farm/livestock exposure).
